title: PHP payment webhook receiver
context: Receives payment provider webhooks. The provider signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using WEBHOOK_SECRET and sends the hex digest in the X-Signature header; bad signatures get 401. Malformed JSON gets 400. The provider retries and may deliver the same event concurrently, and each event id must be processed exactly once (webhook_events.id is a primary key). bootstrap.php provides $pdo.

expected.why: loose != treats digests like "0e123..." as equal numbers and is not constant-time; use hash_equals
json_decode returns null, not false, on invalid JSON, so malformed bodies are never rejected with 400
check-then-insert: two concurrent deliveries both see no row and both process the event; insert the id first and rely on the primary key
